title: ADORABLE RABBITS; SOLID ALL METAL CONSTRUCTION
text: ADORABLE RABBITS; SOLID ALL METAL CONSTRUCTION. Have ordered a couple of other Design Toscano items and they are always top quality and really cute.  These bookends are heavy enough to hold books quite well and the rabbits are adorable.  Truthfully I can't imagine anyone not liking these or finding any problem with them.  These are all metal, so nearly impossible to break.  Very happy with the item.  These would make a great gift too.

product_metadata.title: Design Toscano Kitten Kibitzing Cat Cast Iron Sculptural Bookend Pair
features: Quality foundry cast iron collectible crafted using age old techniques
Each piece is individually hand-painted by our artisans
Exclusive to the Design Toscano brand and perfect for your home or garden
description: This pair of playful kittens are sitting pretty just waiting someone to come along and dangle a string, then they will spring into action with classic self-confident, beguiling grace. Cats known as "Mau" were revered and important to Egyptian society and religion. These enigmatic black kittens will keep your secrets, Gothic tales, mysteries, or Bram Stoker and Edgar Allen Poe volumes safe from harm. Bookends serve as punctuation marks in a library, showcasing your interests, and adding character to any room, shelf, or credenza. This ideal heavyweight pair of Kitten Kibitzing bookends serve as functional art while giving literary support to your favorite books. Hand-crafted in heavyweight foundry cast iron exclusively for Design Toscano, then hand painted and distressed just enough to replicate a true antique. Each 4"Wx3½ "Dx5"H. 3 lbs.
